subject: Why Some Aging Brains Stay Sharp Despite Heavy Alzheimer's Plaques
script: From Agewell Brief: Why Some Aging Brains Stay Sharp Despite Heavy Alzheimer's Plaques. In post-mortem tissue past age 80, rare immature hippocampal neurons preserve memory not by replacing lost cells, but by quieting local brain inflammation. Read the full source-linked dispatch and primary study caveats at AgewellBrief.com.
